resources.string: Search this title using providers configured on your Jellyfin server. Choose a language. Downloads add a file to the server library and may be available to other users.
No subtitles were returned. There may be no match, or a provider may need to be configured by your Jellyfin administrator. Try another language.
The subtitle request failed. Check your connection and the server’s subtitle provider configuration, then try again.
The server did not allow this request. Ask your Jellyfin administrator about subtitle-management permission.
Subtitle lookup is unavailable for this title or server.
%1$s\n\nThis adds a subtitle to the server library for this title. Other users may see it. Download this file?
Download requested. Waiting for the server to refresh this title… Back stops waiting; a server download already sent may still finish.
A new external subtitle is available for this version. Reopen the subtitle picker to choose it.

The request was sent, but a new subtitle was not confirmed for this version. The server may still be refreshing, or its provider may have failed. Recheck the title before requesting the download again.
A new subtitle is available. Refresh playback at your current position to load the updated tracks, then choose it in the subtitle picker. Playback may briefly restart.
